errors.evidence: The dark blue line representing women without children reaches approximately 90% at age 30, not 85%.
The fluctuations of the dark blue line from age 30 to 50 are between approximately 85% and 90%, not 75% and 85%.
The line representing women with children is light blue, not grey.
The line for women with children starts at approximately 25% at age 20, not 40%.

errors.evidence: This description of the trend and value is incorrect. The line does not dip to 55%. It starts around 25%, has a local peak around 40% at age 21, and is at approximately 45% at age 25.

errors.evidence: At age 30, the line for women with children is at approximately 62%, not 70%.

errors.text_span: Danach weist sie bis 50 Jahren wiederum relativ flache Fluktuationen zwischen 60 % und 75 % auf.
errors.evidence: This description is incorrect. From age 30, the line shows a significant upward trend, rising from ~62% to over 80% by age 42. The range of 60-75% is incorrect for the period from 30 to 50.
